description: Reference hub for opencode-coder planning, setup, project-doc guidance, simplify, debugging, and support workflows. Use this skill when the AI assistant needs to plan beads work, set up project docs, run the /simplify workflow, install or initialize bd or opencode-coder, switch stealth/team modes, check health, analyze logs, troubleshoot plugin behavior, generate AGENTS.md guidance, or help report opencode-coder bugs.

results.query: Can you plan this work in beads for me: I need an epic plus child tasks to add a diagnostics bundle command to my OpenCode plugin, and I want an acceptance review task before we close the epic.
I just landed a refactor and want to use the simplify workflow on the files I changed, focusing on duplication and any safe local cleanups before I open a PR.

my repo has AGENTS.md plus a few stale docs in docs/ and I want to run an audit like /opencode-coder/docs so we stop duplicating skill guidance in project docs. can you walk the lifecycle and tell me what should stay local vs skill-only?
OpenCode is acting weird and I need help enabling plugin debug logs, finding the right log directory, and figuring out what to grep for before I report a bug.
We want to switch an initialized repo from stealth to team mode and I need the exact path, git visibility, and saved-mode implications before I touch anything.

Help me explicitly enable opencode-coder in a fresh repo. I want to understand what /opencode-coder/init does now, what files it should create, and how saved disabled differs from the hard-disabled env var.

I think our AGENTS file is too big. Can you use the opencode-coder docs workflow to slim it down into a routing table and decide which docs need to exist versus which topics should route to installed skills?
bd ready is blowing up with database errors in this plugin setup. I need a troubleshooting path, health checks, and a proper bug-report package if it turns out to be an opencode-coder issue.
Can you generate a small AGENTS.md for this repo that routes coding, testing, release, and monitoring work to the right docs or installed skills without turning AGENTS into a handbook?
We had an incident because the release docs missed a required validation script. I want an improve-doc style pass that captures the failure, maps where the guidance belongs, and prevents recurrence.
Write a TypeScript function that groups users by organization and include unit tests.
Review this pull request diff and tell me if the React state updates look safe.
I need help creating a GitHub release for version 1.4.0 and making sure the changelog is ready.
Can you sync our local beads issues with GitHub issues and tell me what changed?
Look at these production logs and triage the top three errors into actionable bugs.
I found a couple typos in docs/TESTING.md and want a quick editorial cleanup only, no lifecycle overhaul.
Show me how to use git worktrees so I can test two branches side by side.
I need a Jira sync workflow for importing sprint tickets into beads.
Can you inspect why my Bun test snapshot changed after I updated a dependency?
Please create a one-off markdown TODO list for this refactor so I can keep notes while I work.
